title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Essential Criteria: The Hamiltonian must be correctly expressed as H = H0 + H with appropriate terms.

title: Eigenfunctions and Degeneracy
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify the eigenfunctions and explain the degeneracy of the energy levels.

title: Energy Corrections
description: Essential Criteria: The calculation of the first and second order energy corrections must be accurate and complete.

title: Perturbation Applicability
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of why non-degenerate perturbation theory is applicable must be clear and correct.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect assumptions about degeneracy must be penalized.
